analysis.summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics reported its Q1 FY27 earnings with consolidated revenue growing 14% year-on-year to INR 281 crores and EBITDA increasing 18% to INR 83 crores. The healthcare segment experienced robust growth, surging 85% year-on-year to INR 142 crores, driven primarily by pen injectors for GLP-1 and other chronic therapies. Management noted ongoing external challenges including geopolitical tensions in West Asia, commodity price volatility, and freight cost pressures, but remained confident in execution and meeting capacity expansion targets. Shaily Engineering Plastics Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting a 14% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenues to Rs. 280.7 crores and an 18% growth in EBITDA to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
guidance.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

guidance.claim: Management indicated that they should be able to go beyond the 36 million full-year guidance.
guidance.quote: Short answer is we should be.

guidance.claim: The company targets to produce around 36 million pens during the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: I think Amit mentioned 36 million, right, Amit?

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and the United States during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance reflected softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and United States, our largest export markets for the business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and USA.
demand_outlook.quote: Weaker Market Demand for Home Furnishings across Europe & USA

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that improved traction in the healthcare segment has been the key driver for overall business growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Improved traction in the healthcare segment has been the key driver for the overall growth of the business

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment degrew in Q4 2026 due to weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment unfortunately de-grew in Q4 '26, primarily reflecting weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S., our 2 largest export markets for this vertical.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are looking at an investment of about INR 5 crores in the existing facility for semiconductor trays.
capex_expansion.quote: Semiconductor Trays, I think we have mentioned that we are looking at investing about INR5 crores in our existing facility, which would meet initial requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that for Consumer Electronics, once a plant is set up down south, the investment will be between INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On Consumer Electronics, again, we have said that once we set up a plant down south, we would be looking at an investment of somewhere between INR80 crores to INR100 crores in that facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Reflecting the confidence in Shaily's next phase of growth and the multiple new opportunities ahead of us, the Board of Directors have approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company estimates an initial capex of around INR100 crores to set up a plant down south for consumer electronics.
capex_expansion.quote: But our estimate is we will need an initial capex of somewhere around INR100 crores when we set up the plant.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved by 120 basis points year-on-year to 29.7% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR83 crores from INR70 crores, reflecting a growth of 18%, while EBITDA margin improved by 120 bps to 29.7%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects gross margins to return to normalized levels by quarter 3.
margins_costs.quote: We expect that the gross margin would come back to normalized level by quarter 3.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q4 FY26 grew 27% year-on-year to INR69 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR69 crores as compared to INR55 crores in Q4 FY '25 a growth of 27% year on year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 29.3%, an increase of 420 basis points over Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 29.3%, an increase of 420 bps Q4 FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q4 FY26 grew 40% year-on-year to INR40 crores.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR40 crores as compared to INR29 crores during Q4 FY '25, a growth of 40% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26, reflecting a gradual improvement in capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: Healthcare segment revenue grew 85% year-on-year to INR 142 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Healthcare continued to deliver robust performance during Q1 FY27. Segment revenue grew 85% year-on-year to INR142 crores, contributing approximately 51% of consolidated revenue and becoming our largest business segment for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company received a new project from an automotive customer.
Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY26 compared to 42.2% in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY '26 compared to 42.2% last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Healthcare segment revenue surged 139% to INR393 crores for the full year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: For the full year, healthcare revenue surged 139% to INR393 crores, contributing 40% of our consolidated revenue, up from 21% in FY '25.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt to equity stood at 0.3x as on 31st March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt to equity stood at 0.3x and our fixed asset turnover ratio stood at 1.7x as on 31st March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that the global operating environment remained challenging due to the geopolitical situation in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global operating environment remained challenging in the quarter with continued uncertainty arising from the geopolitical situation in West Asia and its wider impact on supply chain as well as commodity markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty, particularly due to ongoing tensions across global trade corridors impacting freight movement, supply chain, and input cost dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter has witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty, particularly due to ongoing tensions across global trade corridors, which impacted freight movement, supply chain and input cost dynamics.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the additional 25 million pen capacity to become operational by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to bring the emergency use auto-injector program to a closure by the end of '27.
management_commitments.quote: On the emergency use auto-injector, it's a program that we've been working on for roughly 18 months, and we will bring it to a closure by the end of '27.

management_commitments.claim: Both production lines are targeted to produce at 65 to 67 parts per minute effectively by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: See, what our target is that by the end of the year, both lines should be able to produce at 65 to 67 parts per minute effectively, which gives us a combined capacity of both these 2 new lines of around 40 million to 42 million pens combined.

management_commitments.claim: Supplies for the semiconductor tray client will start in Quarter 4 of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Quarter 4 of the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
